company_name: Baoji Hengye Non-ferrous Metal Technology Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — Baoji Hengye specializes in rare metals and alloys that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Baoji Hengye Non-ferrous Metal Technology Co., Ltd. is a leading supplier of rare metal targets and high-temperature alloys essential for semiconductor applications. The company offers a wide range of products including tubes, bars, wires, and sputtering targets, supporting various semiconductor fabrication processes.
capabilities: Production of rare metal targets for sputtering
Manufacturing of high-temperature alloys and refractory metals
Vacuum heat treatment and welding services

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Baoji, Shaanxi Province, a hub for non-ferrous metal processing.
